items.title: 21.10 Samandari dhaarein aur hawa ke naqshe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ocean currents and wind patterns (PDF 179).

blocks.text: Samandari currents (dhaarein) aur hawa ke patterns zameen ke climate aur mausam ko qaboo (regulate) karne mein aham kirdar ada karte hain. Ocean currents samandar ke pani ki bare paimane ki harkat se bante hain. Samandar ka pani do tareeqon se gardish (circulation) karta hai: surface (satah) par aur gehri tahon ke darmiyan. Surface currents zyada tar hawa se bante hain jo samandar ki oopar wali tah ka pani dhakelti hai. Pani ki vertical (oopar-neeche) gardish ko thermohaline circulation kehte hain. Yeh pani ke temperature aur salinity (namkeenpan) ke farq se chalti hai, kyunke yeh dono pani ki density (ghana-pan) par asar karte hain (21.13 aur 21.14 dekhein). Zameen ka ghoomna bhi samandar ki harkat ko shakal deta hai aur bare gol currents ke nizam banata hai jinhein gyres kehte hain. Yeh northern hemisphere (shimali nisf-kurrah) mein clockwise (ghari ki suiyon ki simt) aur southern hemisphere (junoobi nisf-kurrah) mein anticlockwise ghoomte hain. Currents garam pani equator se poles ki taraf le jati hain aur thanda pani wapas lati hain, jis se zameen ka climate qaboo mein rehta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit! (Dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Purane malahon (sailors) ko safar mein madad dene wali trade winds zameen ke ghoomne aur Sooraj ki garmi se chalti hain. Ocean currents duniya ke mausami pattern badal kar aik ilaqe mein selab (floods) aur doosre mein khushk-sali (drought) la sakti hain.

blocks.prompt: Southern hemisphere mein aik toofani nizam (storm system) clockwise ghoomta dekha gaya. Agar wahi nizam northern hemisphere mein ho to kis taraf ghoomega, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Anticlockwise. Coriolis effect chalti hawa ko southern hemisphere mein baen (left) aur northern hemisphere mein daen (right) morta hai, is liye kam dabao (low pressure) wale toofan ki taraf aane wali hawa dono hemispheres mein ulti simt mein ghoomti hai.

blocks.text: Samandar ki surface par gyres ke patterns Fig. 21.11 mein dikhaye gaye hain. Hawa ke patterns zameen ki surface ke na-barabar garam hone se bante hain: garam hawa oopar uthti hai aur thandi hawa us ki jagah aati hai. Is se hawa ke alag belts bante hain, jaise trade winds, westerlies aur polar easterlies. Yeh hawayein na sirf samandar ki surface ka pani chalati hain balke ocean currents ki simt aur taqat par bhi asar karti hain. Hawa ke patterns aur ocean currents mil kar poori zameen par garmi aur energy phailate hain, aur climate zones aur mausam ko badalte hain.

blocks.alt: Duniya ka naqsha aur paanch samandari gyres: North Pacific aur North Atlantic clockwise; South Pacific, South Atlantic aur Indian anticlockwise. Narangi teer garam aur neele teer thandi dhaarein; garam pani basins ke maghribi kinaron par. Antarctic circumpolar current junoob mein maghrib se mashriq behti hai. Legend: cold current, warm current.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.11: samandar ki satah par gyres ke naqshe (kitab ki Figure 21.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Surface currents: hawa se; vertical gardish (thermohaline): temperature aur salinity (density) se.
Gyres: northern mein clockwise, southern mein anticlockwise.
Wind belts: trade winds, westerlies, polar easterlies; currents ke saath garmi phailate hain.
